aluminum_can.note: Aluminum cans listed as acceptable metal; keep free of liquids/food
aluminum_can.quote: Aluminum cans Aluminum foil and trays (ball foil up to softball size)

steel_can.note: Steel (tin) cans listed as acceptable metal

glass_bottle_jar.note: Glass bottles and jars accepted, no liquids or food

plastic_bottle.note: Plastic bottles accepted, leave caps on

plastic_tub.note: Tubs, lids, containers and clamshells accepted if empty
plastic_tub.quote: Tubs and lids (i.e., yogurt containers and Tupperware)

plastic_bag_film.note: Plastic bags and film go in the trash

pizza_box_greasy.note: Greasy pizza boxes are soiled paper, not recyclable
pizza_box_greasy.quote: Soiled paper (paper plates, napkins, tissues, towels, take-out boxes, and greasy pizza boxes)

paper_cup.note: Empty coffee cups accepted under paper

milk_carton.note: Paper milk, juice and beverage cartons accepted
milk_carton.quote: Paper milk, juice, and other beverage cartons

foam.note: Plastic cups and plates only; no styrofoam in the blue bin
foam.quote: cups and plates (plastic only, no styrofoam)

aluminum_foil.note: Foil and trays accepted; ball foil up to softball size
aluminum_foil.quote: Aluminum foil and trays (ball foil up to softball size)

food_waste.note: Food scraps go in the green compost cart
food_waste.quote: We accept food scraps, soiled paper, and plants in the green composting cart.

battery.note: Household batteries: special handling, not in any bin
battery.quote: Special handling. Don't put in any bin.

other_trash.note: Non-recyclable items belong in trash, not blue bin
other_trash.quote: A few things, once they are used, are actually trash.
